role: Independent read-only review; no application edits, commit, deployment, or real-money activity
reviewed_scope: MONEY-01 Flutterwave v3 verification and pending reconciliation
bounded additional password reset / OTP source traversal
result: Focused fixes materially improve behavior; whole auth/payment production release remains blocked by additional defects and missing qualified human/provider review.
verified_properties: MFA challenge issued only after password validation; hashed random proof, five-minute expiry, account/role/secret binding, stored remember choice, atomic proof + backup-code consumption + session insertion.
Standalone email and valid MFA code cannot replace password proof; ten simultaneous proof completions create only one session; session insert failure rolls back proof and backup consumption.
Active company membership checked on every request; suspended and invited members denied; current permissions authoritative; owners retain intended ownership access.

Flutterwave v3 server response requires exact merchant reference and currency, successful status, explicit decimal major-unit amount, and positive integer expected kobo amount; malformed/sub-kobo/underpaid values denied; overpayment not misread as expected minor units.

Scheduler reconciliation retains provider-missing and unknown/pending outcomes past former eight-attempt threshold; confirmed failed outcomes retire intents; oldest-unchecked ordering prevents pending batch starvation; twenty concurrent confirmations credit once.

Corrected web harness freshly passes role redirects, session update ordering, missing/expired proof denial, genuine setup error, backup-code UI, session-only proof storage without password/email storage.

verification.result: Initial harness failed parsing .ts as TSX; root corrected harness, not application behavior.

verification.note: These temporary tests prove observed defects; passing repro assertions do not mean correct production behavior.

required_findings.title: Reset-code guesses have no durable per-code cap
required_findings.evidence: Ten wrong reset-code requests all returned 400 while verification_codes.attempts remained 0 and consumed_at NULL. AuthLimiter applies only per process/IP; it does not substitute for a durable code cap.
required_findings.disposition: Root assigned focused AUTH02 implementer; not fixed at this review snapshot.

required_findings.title: Concurrent reset-code replay can change password repeatedly
required_findings.evidence: Four simultaneous reset-password requests using one code all returned 200. Code is read before transaction; consume UPDATE does not recheck unconsumed state under lock.
required_findings.disposition: Root assigned focused AUTH02 implementer; not fixed at this review snapshot.

required_findings.title: Pending MFA proof survives password reset and opens a new session
required_findings.evidence: Real local HTTP: password login issued challenge; successful reset revoked sessions; old challenge and valid TOTP returned 200 and created one new unrevoked session. Challenge context binds MFA secret but not password revision; reset/change leaves it live.
required_findings.disposition: Root assigned AUTH02 proof invalidation; not fixed at this review snapshot.

required_findings.title: OTP attempt count is overwritten from stale reads and fifth wrong guess leaves code usable
required_findings.evidence: Source-confirmed: attempts = record.attempts + 1 followed by unconditional assignment races concurrent guesses; burn condition is >5, and valid-code consumption does not reject attempts>=5. No new HTTP reproduction run in this bounded review.
required_findings.disposition: Reported to root for focused OTP correction and regression evidence.

required_findings.title: Old phone code can verify a replacement contact
required_findings.evidence: Source-confirmed: profile changes phone and clears phone_verified but leaves outstanding phone_verify codes; code records bind user/purpose without contact target, and confirm marks current phone verified. No new HTTP reproduction run in this bounded review.
required_findings.disposition: Reported to root for OTP/contact invalidation coverage.

required_findings.title: Customer confirm path still retires pending outcome despite scheduler fix
required_findings.evidence: Source-confirmed: wallet/topup/confirm sets failed for every !verification.paid response. A valid reference with processor pending status becomes excluded from scheduler pending selection and completeTopUp status=pending condition.
required_findings.disposition: Root already owns customer-confirm terminal-state correction and legacy Paystack review.

official_sources.checked: Current docs explicitly require matching reference, successful status, expected currency, amount >= expected; v3 major units example and amount field agree with fix.
Current v3 docs still describe verif-hash secret equality, require server requery before giving value, and recommend polling until successful or failed; no change to webhook protocol inferred.

blocked_release_evidence: Qualified human review of authentication, authorization, tenant isolation, and money flows before production release.
Real provider sandbox/staging confirmation, webhook settings/retry access, bank/provider reconciliation, timeout-after-charge behavior, recovery and monitoring evidence.
Full browser and production build review after fixes; current bounded review ran client harness, not browser end-to-end.
